justification: After the flood-distance speed-up the live evidence call still takes a median 14.6 s on 34 real pilot-council lots, while the same call takes 2 to 3 s on a developer PC and the live area check alone takes about 5 s. The service log shows no warnings, so the extra time cannot be read from it. This change logs how long each stage of the evidence call takes (the lot outline, the map layers, the pipeline lookups, the flood study, the walks, the route map, the council controls and files) as 'lmr stage <name> <seconds>' lines through uvicorn's logger. It changes no answer and no response field; every stage call passes its result and its exceptions straight through.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_lmr_stage_timings.py tests/test_lmr_area_inputs.py tests/test_evidence_statement.py -q -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The timer changes a stage's return value or swallows its exception, or the line goes to a logger the service log does not show.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Not measured by hand breakage: the helper is a 6-line pass-through. The three tests assert the value and exception pass through, the stage line is logged for success and for failure, and the logger is uvicorn's. The existing 155 area-check and evidence tests, which call every wrapped stage, still pass.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stage timings exist; the service log carries only uvicorn access lines. uvicorn.error is configured at INFO by uvicorn, the module's own logger has no setup so its INFO lines are dropped.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: An earlier belief that the live lookups ran one after another was wrong: fetch_layers already runs them in parallel. The remaining time on the live service is not visible from outside.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New: a pass-through timer at about twelve call sites and one test file. Unchanged: every answer, every response field and the order of the calls.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: the timer only measures.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A planner waits about 15 seconds for the evidence page and nobody can say which stage causes it.
